GR00T N2: 2× VLA task success rate (DreamZero architecture)

discoveries.title: xAI Grok 4.3 — Always-On Reasoning, 1M Context, Native Video

discoveries.title: Meta TRIBE v2 — Open-Source Digital Twin of Human Neural Activity
key_features: Predicts whole-brain fMRI responses to images/video/audio/text
discoveries.notes: First foundation model for human neural prediction. Predicted brain responses more correlated with group average than real individual scans. Opens biological alignment axis for AI evaluation.

discoveries.title: DeepSeek mHC — Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections for Stable Deep Training
key_features: Manifold constraint: information conserved not amplified across layers
Stable training at 3B/9B/27B vs unstable Hyper-Connections
discoveries.notes: Solves gradient explosion in deep networks via conservation constraint. Expected to enter major training frameworks (Megatron, HF Transformers) within 6-12 months.

discoveries.title: Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview + Project Glasswing — AI Autonomous Zero-Day Discovery
key_features: Autonomous zero-day CVE discovery across all major OSes/browsers
discoveries.notes: First AI to surpass human security researchers at real exploit discovery. Deliberately kept from public release — governance-first distribution model.

discoveries.title: AWS Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments — AI Agents Transact with USDC (Coinbase + Stripe)
discoveries.notes: First production payment rail for AI agents. Removes last human-in-the-loop for transactional agentic workflows. Unlocks agentic economy.

discoveries.title: OpenAI GPT-Realtime-2 + Translate + Whisper — Agentic Voice GA

Preamble support for tool execution UX
